claim: Keyframe mode decides whether the shot is a single still driven into motion by i2v or an interpolation between two or three authored frames. Reach for start_end when the shot has to arrive somewhere specific, and start_mid_end when the middle of the move is the point.
not_visual: The variable is about how many authored frames feed the video pass and what happens between them. A still is by definition one frame, so all three values produce the identical panel.
